pillar_reactions.evidence: Rep screen-shared the Primal University movement library and mobility module; prospect probed whether it could be individualised - 'with that, am I able to go on there and, like, kind of build, like, put in, like, specifically what I'm trying to build, focus more on, and kind of get a routine that way?' Answer was no: 'the program, it's not tailored to your specific needs.'

Presented only in passing as a module inside the self-serve product - 'there are also his nutrition and fasting protocols.' Prospect dismissed the need: 'I wasn't really looking at it as far as to be like motivated, like on a meal plan or anything like that. I know all about intermittent fasting.'

The rep presented accountability as the thing the prospect does not need - 'you don't need someone checking in on you every single week.' The prospect initially agreed and then pushed back on the substance: 'what if I had the money and still wanted to do it, you know, to get coaching to get like feedback on my on my uh technique so i can push myself more.'

anchors.raw: I know I can figure it out. I've been looking at videos on the forum, you know, how you gotta it up... I'm very resourceful, very like, you know, uh, with anything that I do.
anchors.note: His working comparison is free instructional video plus his own dumbbells and bands. Against that, $200/mo already read as 'kind of expensive for just workout programs'.

anchors.raw: I said, well, let me see how much something like this will cost. I think I can do this for six months, you know, if it's affordable.
anchors.note: He arrived with an explicit affordability gate stated in the first fifteen minutes and the rep never quantified it before deciding the fit.

unmet_demand.want: One-to-one form feedback and a leg-focused programme built around a truck-stop schedule, which he offered to pay for
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The programme does exactly this - it is the core $6,000 offer - but the rep judged him self-sufficient and steered him to a self-paced product that he had already been told is 'not tailored to your specific needs'. The want was declined rather than unserved.

unmet_demand.want: A trial or reduced first month before committing
unmet_demand.why_unmet: No trial or introductory tier exists and discounts were refused outright.
